Our Story

A Little Café with a Big Heart

Four Little Foxes was born from a simple idea: that every person who walks through our doors deserves exceptional coffee, beautiful food and a moment to truly slow down. Nestled in the heart of Milperra, we've built a space where quality meets warmth, and where every cup really does tell a story.

Our chefs craft seasonal menus using the finest local produce, our baristas source single-origin beans from Deluca Coffee, and our team treats every guest like family. That's the Four Little Foxes promise.
